rules: The message journal row and its audit-chain entry commit in one SQLite transaction.
A singleton anchor stores the committed entry count and head hash.
Baseline.3 databases with no audit-chain rows may be backfilled exactly once and then receive the durable migration marker.
After the migration marker exists, an empty, partial, gapped, mutated, or anchor-mismatched chain is never silently repaired.
This chain detects accidental or unsophisticated local tampering; production device attestation and protected key storage remain separate concerns.
